locator.title: Топ-6 нестандартных планировок квартир от Level Group
locator.lead: Покажем несколько вариантов в разных районах Москвы
locator.caption: В просторной гостиной или столовой утром будет приятно собираться всей семьёй за завтраком, а вечером — ужинать и делиться новостями за день

image_reading: A double-height contemporary dining area with a round table, upholstered chairs, tall floor-to-ceiling windows, sheer curtains, a sculptural pendant light, and an illuminated wooden staircase.
Daylight enters from the right; the curtains and hanging light are the visibly plausible sources of subtle motion.
analysis.article_context: Body image following the section on a two-level loft with a separate entrance; its caption presents the spacious dining area as a place for family breakfasts and evening conversations. The animation should emphasize the airy, premium shared living space.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The spacious two-level home is an inviting shared setting for everyday family gatherings.
structured_intent.primary_action: A gentle breeze moves the sheer curtains and gradually opens warm daylight across the dining area.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The round dining table and surrounding floor are visibly washed in soft warm daylight, while the curtains settle into a faint drift.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The room remains a calm, refined and welcoming communal space throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, a gentle airflow draws the tall sheer curtains slightly inward and lets them ease back, continuously revealing more warm window light across the dining table and nearby floor. Keep the camera fixed on the table and pendant. The light reaches a calm, inviting full spread near the end; the curtains and pendant retain only a faint residual motion.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the dining area. The sheer curtains slowly breathe inward in a light breeze while warm daylight gradually spreads across the table and floor; by the final frame the dining table is softly illuminated and the pendant has settled almost still.

models.scene_plan: For the full five seconds, use the window breeze as one continuous process: the sheer curtains make a restrained inward billow, then relax while daylight progressively opens across the dining zone. Keep a fixed wide composition so the double-height space remains readable. Arrive close to the end at a visibly brighter, welcoming table with a natural soft settling.
models.positive_prompt: A fixed view of the dining space: sheer curtains drift gently toward the room as warm daylight slowly expands over the round table and floor, ending with the table clearly bathed in soft light.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, make the curtains closest to the windows gently pull inward and release in one smooth breeze-driven cycle, letting the daylight expand across the table and floor. Maintain the fixed framing and an even pace. The endpoint is a clearly sunlit dining area, with only subtle remaining curtain motion.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the round dining table. A light breeze gently moves the sheer curtains, revealing a growing wash of warm daylight across the table and floor; the final frame holds the softly sunlit dining area.
